description: Offer the person up to three Mosaya practices they can do right here (meditation, breathwork, mindfulness, loving-kindness, gratitude, a focus timer and more). Use when they want to meditate, calm down, settle a racing mind, sleep, focus, or ask for a practice by name. Shows a card; nothing is stored. If their words sound like crisis, the card shows care and crisis lines instead of practices.

minutes.description: A length the person asked for, if they named one.

need.description: What the person is looking for, in their own words, short: a feeling, a need, or a practice's name (for example "can't switch off", "loving-kindness", "focus for an hour").

name: find_practice
title: Find a practice
